<!-- Source page: Geoclue -->

[Geoclue](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/geoclue/geoclue) is a D-Bus geoinformation service. Geoclue can give you a location based on device GPS, a GPS of a device on your network, 3G modems, GeoIP, or WiFi.

Many of these may require additional setup, such as WiFi which once relied on <a href="mozillawiki:CloudServices/Location" class="wikilink" title="Mozilla Location Service">Mozilla Location Service</a>, but that service is now retired. Alternatives such as [beaconDB](https://beacondb.net/) may be used as a drop in replacement. Option may be found under [services.geoclue2](https://search.nixos.org/options?query=services.geoclue2).
